problem:
Calculate the volume $V$ of the parallelepiped spanned by $x=⟨1,2,3⟩$, $y=⟨0,1,-1⟩$, and $z=⟨2,0,1⟩.$

$V=${{field-1}}

feedback.problem:
Calculate the volume $V$ of the parallelepiped spanned by $x=⟨1,1,2⟩$, $y=⟨-3,2,0⟩$, and $z=⟨4,-2,1⟩.$

$V=${{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
The volume of the parallelepiped spanned by three vectors is given by the absolute value of their triple product.

First, we compute the triple product:

$$
\begin{aligned}x\cdot (y\times z) & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 2 \\ -3 & 2 & 0 \\ 4 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|-1\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 \\ 4 & 1\end{aligned}|+2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & 2 \\ 4 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1(2\cdot 1-0\cdot (-2))-1((-3)\cdot 1-0\cdot 4)+2((-3)\cdot (-2)-2\cdot 4) \\  & =2+3-4 \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we take the absolute value. So, the volume of the corresponding parallelepiped is 

$$
V=|1|=1.
$$
